Venezuela Earthquakes: Devastation and Response Efforts

A series of earthquakes in Venezuela has resulted in significant loss of life and displacement. The international community is responding to the disaster, while local officials face criticism for their response. In India, a warehouse collapse in Kolkata has claimed several lives.
